terraformregistries.description: A Terraform namespace on the configured registry host.

providers.description: A Terraform provider. The resource ID is its provider type within the namespace group. Populated from the provider registry protocol, discovered through the 'providers.v1' service discovery identifier.

name.description: The provider type, verbatim and unaltered (e.g. 'aws'). This is the authoritative name of the provider; the providerid is only an addressing key derived from it.

version.description: The released version string exactly as published, including any build metadata introduced by '+'. This is the authoritative version; the versionid is a transliteration of it and MUST NOT be reversed.

namespace.description: The namespace (owner) of the provider on the Terraform Registry (e.g., hashicorp).

type.description: The type identifier of the provider (e.g., aws).

source.description: Canonical provider source address namespace/type, as written in a Terraform required_providers block.

sourceurl.description: Base URL of the Terraform registry this provider was projected from, e.g. 'https://registry.terraform.io'. This records provenance only and is not part of the provider's identity.

published_at.description: UTC timestamp when this provider Version was published. OPTIONAL public-registry extension; the providers.v1 protocol does not return publication timestamps, so this attribute MAY be absent.

protocols.description: Plugin protocol versions declared for this Version by the 'List Available Versions' response. This is the release-level declaration used to decide whether a Terraform CLI can use the release at all. It is distinct from the per-platform 'protocols' value inside 'platforms', which the 'Find a Provider Package' response returns for one concrete package; the two MUST NOT be merged.

os.description: Operating system of the package. Returned by both 'List Available Versions' and 'Find a Provider Package'.

arch.description: Architecture of the package. Returned by both 'List Available Versions' and 'Find a Provider Package'.

protocols.description: Plugin protocol versions of this concrete package. Requires a 'Find a Provider Package' round trip and MAY be absent.

filename.description: Distributed archive filename. Requires a 'Find a Provider Package' round trip and MAY be absent.

download_url.description: Location of the package archive. Requires a 'Find a Provider Package' round trip and MAY be absent. MAY be a relative reference resolved against the URL that returned the containing JSON object.

shasums_url.description: Location of the SHA256SUMS document. Requires a 'Find a Provider Package' round trip and MAY be absent. MAY be a relative reference.

shasums_signature_url.description: Location of the detached signature over the SHA256SUMS document. Requires a 'Find a Provider Package' round trip and MAY be absent. MAY be a relative reference.

shasum.description: SHA256 checksum of this package archive. Requires a 'Find a Provider Package' round trip and MAY be absent.

key_id.description: GPG key ID of the signing key.

trust_signature.description: Registry operator countersignature over the publisher key, when present.

signing_keys.description: Signing keys for this package. The providers.v1 protocol makes this a REQUIRED property of the per-platform 'Find a Provider Package' response, so it is modeled per platform and not per Version. It requires that round trip and MAY be absent when only the 'List Available Versions' summary has been projected.

platforms.description: Packages of this provider Version. The 'List Available Versions' response supplies only the os/arch pairs; every other field of an entry, including signing_keys, comes from a separate per-platform 'Find a Provider Package' request and MAY be absent. Implementations MUST NOT synthesize the missing fields.

defaultversionsticky.description: Sticky default Versions are not supported: the default Version is always the highest published SemVer.

downloads.description: Total cumulative download count. OPTIONAL public-registry UI extension; not part of the providers.v1 protocol. Third-party registry implementations SHOULD NOT populate it, because such extensions may change in future without notice.

tier.description: Provider support classification. OPTIONAL public-registry UI extension; not part of the providers.v1 protocol. Third-party registry implementations SHOULD NOT populate it, because such extensions may change in future without notice.

logo_url.description: URL to the provider's logo image. OPTIONAL public-registry UI extension; not part of the providers.v1 protocol. Third-party registry implementations SHOULD NOT populate it, because such extensions may change in future without notice.

categories.description: Categories that describe the provider's purpose. OPTIONAL public-registry UI extension; not part of the providers.v1 protocol. Third-party registry implementations SHOULD NOT populate it, because such extensions may change in future without notice.

featured.description: Whether the provider is featured on the public Terraform Registry. OPTIONAL public-registry UI extension; not part of the providers.v1 protocol. Third-party registry implementations SHOULD NOT populate it, because such extensions may change in future without notice.

unlisted.description: Whether the provider is hidden from public registry listings. OPTIONAL public-registry UI extension; not part of the providers.v1 protocol. Third-party registry implementations SHOULD NOT populate it, because such extensions may change in future without notice.

warning.description: Deprecation or advisory message published by the registry operator. OPTIONAL public-registry UI extension; not part of the providers.v1 protocol. Third-party registry implementations SHOULD NOT populate it, because such extensions may change in future without notice.

aliases.description: Alternate source addresses for this provider. OPTIONAL public-registry UI extension; not part of the providers.v1 protocol. Third-party registry implementations SHOULD NOT populate it, because such extensions may change in future without notice.

modules.description: A Terraform module. The resource ID is name~provider within the namespace group, or a hashed form where that is not available. Populated from the module registry protocol, discovered through the 'modules.v1' service discovery identifier.

name.description: The module name component, verbatim and unaltered (e.g. 'consul'). This is the authoritative name of the module; the moduleid is only an addressing key and MAY be a hash, in which case this attribute is the only place the name appears.

version.description: The released version string exactly as published, including any build metadata introduced by '+'. This is the authoritative version; the versionid is a transliteration of it and MUST NOT be reversed.

id.description: Upstream module identifier as returned by the module registry protocol, of the form namespace/name/system/version.

namespace.description: The namespace (owner) of the module on the Terraform Registry.

provider.description: The provider system this module targets (e.g., aws). Part of the module's identity, not a dependency declaration.

source_address.description: Canonical module source address namespace/name/provider, as written in a Terraform module block. This is the address used when addressing the upstream registry. It is not a field returned by the protocol; it is composed from namespace, name and provider.

source.description: Repository URL of the module, as returned verbatim in the upstream 'source' field (e.g., https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-aws-consul). It locates the module's source code and is NOT the canonical Terraform source address; see source_address for that.

sourceurl.description: Base URL of the Terraform registry this module was projected from, e.g. 'https://registry.terraform.io'. This records provenance only and is not part of the module's identity.

download_url.description: Module package source address returned in the X-Terraform-Get response header of the modules.v1 '/:namespace/:name/:system/:version/download' endpoint. This is the value a client needs in order to retrieve and install the module. If relative, it is resolved against the URL of the download request.

published_at.description: UTC timestamp when this module Version was published.

providers.description: Provider systems for which a module of this name exists in this namespace, as returned in the upstream 'providers' list. These are sibling identities, not dependencies.

versions.description: All published version strings of this module, as returned in the upstream 'versions' list. Informational; the authoritative projection of releases is the xRegistry Versions collection.

path.description: Path of this module within the source repository. Empty for the root module.

empty.description: Whether this module declares no Terraform configuration.

type.description: Declared Terraform type constraint of the input.

default.description: JSON-encoded default value of the input, if any.

required.description: Whether the input has no default and must be supplied by the caller.

inputs.description: Input variables declared by this module.

outputs.description: Output values produced by this module.

name.description: Local name of the called module.

source.description: Source address of the called module.

version.description: Version constraint on the called module.

name.description: Local name of the required provider.

source.description: Source address of the required provider.

version.description: Version constraint on the required provider.

name.description: Local name of the managed resource or data source.

resources.description: Resources and data sources declared by this module.

root.description: Interface contract of the module's root module: its inputs, outputs, called modules, required providers, declared resources and README.

path.description: Path of this submodule within the source repository.

empty.description: Whether this submodule declares no Terraform configuration.

type.description: Declared Terraform type constraint of the input.

default.description: JSON-encoded default value of the input, if any.

required.description: Whether the input has no default and must be supplied by the caller.

inputs.description: Input variables declared by this submodule.

outputs.description: Output values produced by this submodule.

name.description: Local name of the called module.

source.description: Source address of the called module.

version.description: Version constraint on the called module.

name.description: Local name of the required provider.

source.description: Source address of the required provider.

version.description: Version constraint on the required provider.

name.description: Local name of the managed resource or data source.

resources.description: Resources and data sources declared by this submodule.

submodules.description: Nested modules published within the same package, each with its own interface contract.

defaultversionsticky.description: Sticky default Versions are not supported: the default Version is always the highest published SemVer.

downloads.description: Total cumulative download count for the module, reported per module and not per Version. OPTIONAL public-registry UI extension; not part of the modules.v1 protocol.

verified.description: Whether the module is verified by HashiCorp. OPTIONAL public-registry UI extension; not part of the modules.v1 protocol.

owner.description: Account that owns the module repository. OPTIONAL public-registry UI extension; not part of the modules.v1 protocol.

trusted.description: Whether the module publisher is trusted. OPTIONAL public-registry UI extension; not part of the modules.v1 protocol.

namespace.description: Canonical Terraform namespace and xRegistry group ID.

sourceurl.description: Base URL of the Terraform registry from which these modules and providers were projected, e.g. 'https://registry.terraform.io'. This records provenance only; a source address denotes the same module or provider whichever registry serves it.

providers_v1.description: Value of the 'providers.v1' service discovery identifier published by the registry host at /.well-known/terraform.json. Absent when the host does not implement the provider registry protocol, in which case the providers collection is permanently empty.

modules_v1.description: Value of the 'modules.v1' service discovery identifier published by the registry host at /.well-known/terraform.json. Absent when the host does not implement the module registry protocol, in which case the modules collection is permanently empty.
